# 唐苑容 Yuanrong Tang

> 唐苑容是 CCNeed 联合创始人兼 COO、清华大学人机交互研究者，工作连接 AI 产品、消费者研究、Agent 系统与企业 AI 转型。

- Canonical homepage: https://xn--sxrw8m230b.com/
- Chinese name: 唐苑容
- English name: Yuanrong Tang
- Current role: Co-founder and COO, CCNeed
- Organization: 远见琢实（上海）智能科技有限公司
- Product: https://ccneed.ai/
- Location: Beijing and Shanghai, China
- Contact: tangxtong2022@gmail.com

## Current work

- Building CCNeed, an AI consumer research platform for product, market, and research teams.
- Connecting public user signals and enterprise knowledge to support decisions about user needs, product opportunities, and market change.
- Working across product direction, commercialization, user research, and enterprise AI transformation.

## Research themes

- Conversational Agents: dialogue context, long-term memory and relationships, adaptive communication, and safety-sensitive interaction.
- Expertise as Agent Capability: making expert judgment, methods, knowledge, and responsibility boundaries callable and verifiable by agents.
- Simulation and Evaluation: user, behavior, scenario, embodied-agent, and multi-agent simulation before real-world deployment.

## Academic and professional context

- Master's student in Information Art and Design at Tsinghua University.
- Jointly trained at the Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University.
- Research at the Future Laboratory, Tsinghua University; Professor Shi Yuanchun serves as second advisor.
- Bachelor's degree in Art and Technology from Tsinghua University.
- Selected by Leiphone as a 25 Under 25 best post-2000 entrepreneur.
